text.tspan: Every workload subnet drops all traffic by default. One narrow exception: HTTPS 443, spoke2 → spoke1.
1 Egress rule 100 on the spoke2 NSG lets it leave
2 Ingress rule 100 on the spoke1 NSG lets it in
NSG state does not cross NSG boundaries:
two rules, one logical flow. 100 beats 4096.
spoke1 → spoke2 (reverse), and every other port or protocol: denied
Deliberately has no NSG so private-link traffic is never dropped before the endpoint.
